description: Knowledge graph from text (grounded) — Turn text into a knowledge graph: entities (person, organization, location, product, event, date, money, concept) and subject-predicate-object relations, each with a short evidence quote. Every relation's quote is checked offline against your text (exact/close/partial/not_found) and relations whose endpoints are not in the text are dropped. Returns entities with mention counts and degree, relations, most central entities, a ready-to-render Mermaid graph and a GROUNDED/MOSTLY_GROUNDED/REVIEW verdict. Optional: focus=, max_relations (3-40, default 25). Up to 12,000 chars. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Tim Cook is the CEO of Apple. Apple is headquartered in Cupertino, California. In 2014 Apple acquired Beats Electronics for $3 billion.

name: ai_knowledge_graph
